WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(a.account_id) as account_count
  FROM district d
  LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE a.district_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
),
region_averages AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(account_count) as region_avg
  FROM district_counts
  GROUP BY region
),
above_average_districts AS (
  SELECT dc.district_id, dc.region, dc.account_count, 
         (dc.account_count - ra.region_avg) as above_average
  FROM district_counts dc
  JOIN region_averages ra ON dc.region = ra.region
  WHERE dc.account_count > ra.region_avg
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(account_count) as overall_avg
  FROM above_average_districts
)
SELECT aad.district_id, aad.region, aad.account_count, 
       aad.above_average,
       CAST(aad.account_count AS REAL) / oa.overall_avg as ratio
FROM above_average_districts aad
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
